name: 002-invoice-payments
statements: CREATE TABLE invoice_payments(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,invoice_id TEXT NOT NULL,organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,amount TEXT NOT NULL,currency TEXT NOT NULL,payment_date TEXT NOT NULL,method TEXT NOT NULL,external_reference TEXT,note TEXT,actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,UNIQUE(organization_id,id),FOREIGN KEY(invoice_id)REFERENCES issued_invoices(id))STRICT
